narr: A cold front passed through the area on the 7th, leading to a few showers and thunderstorms. Some thunderstorms caused heavy rainfall in a short period of time that led to isolated instances of flooding and flash flooding in northern Virginia.
ev: A water rescue occurred in the area of South Joyce Street and Army Navy Drive. Several vehicles were stranded in high water. Crews were utilizing rescue boats.
